notes: This is a flexible Nairobi/stopover option not yet in CLAUDE.md's known priced list - a budget-friendly tented option in Karen.
The general Porini 2-night minimum stay explicitly does NOT apply here.
This is one of the cheapest Nairobi-area options seen in this extraction batch.

dayRoom.raw: 70% of contracted room rate, 12:00 check-in to 18:00 check-out

reducedRate_6nightsOffer_bb_perPersonSha.note: This reduced rate applies only when extending a qualifying 6-night Porini multi-camp stay - not a standalone discount.

childPolicy.raw: Sharing with 2 adults in a tent: normal child sharing rate. 2 children in own tent: 75% each of per-person-sharing rate; 3rd child in same tent: 75%. 1 child sharing with 1 adult: child pays 75% of adult sharing rate, adult pays per-adult-sharing rate. 1 child sharing with 2 adults: child rate above, adults pay double tent rate. Under 3: free. Max 1 child sharing with 2 adults per tent (space limit). 3rd adult in a tent not recommended (limited space) but if booked, pays per-person-sharing rate with foldable camp bed.
childPolicy.reducedRateOfferChildPolicy: 3-12 years sharing with 2 adults: 50% of the above rates (under 3 free) - per the 6-night reduced-rate offer document specifically.

excludes: Christmas/New Year supplement 24/25/26/31 Dec & 1 Jan: $40pp/night incl. 16% VAT

additionalFees.poriniWildlifeHabitatTrustPayment: US$5 per person per night, non-commissionable

oneWayCampTransfers_inclVAT.note: Per vehicle, min 2 pax max 4 pax

sharedTermsNote: Deposit/cancellation policy identical to other Porini properties - see porini-amboseli-camp-2026.json. NOTE: camp is stated as 'not suitable for children under 8 years of age' in the 6-night reduced-rate offer's terms section, which conflicts with the main rate card's own under-3/3-12 child pricing bands - both quoted verbatim, not reconciled.
